newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT Germany to transfer Henkel warehouse management.
newsitem.headline: TNT Germany to transfer Henkel warehouse management.

text.p: International express company TNT said it has agreed to hand over management of a Henkel KGaA warehouse in Duesseldorf on August 31.
The new operator of the 110-staff centre for the German pharmaceuticals group will be freight forwarder Cretschmar GmbH & Co KG, a TNT Germany statement said.
Vinzenz Wagner, chairman of TNT Holding in Germany, said Henkel, TNT and Cretschmar agreed on the management change to permit warehousing and transport by a single company.
TNT was contracted by Henkel in 1992 to plan, build and operate the centre with 70,000 pallet positions for nearly 2,800 different articles but had not been responsible for distribution.

Wagner said: "We agreed with Henkel to hand over our warehouse activity to Cretschmar since we are both convinced that warehousing and transport from one source permits further quality advantages and distribution improvements."
The Cretschmar group, an international forwarding firm, generated sales revenue of 200 million German marks in 1996 with some 670 employees.
